set.body: Move array writing from the JVM filesystem special case into a shared, store-independent Scala 3 model. Add explicit create-only ObjectWriter and AsyncObjectWriter capabilities whose atomic unit is one immutable object; conflict, transport, and unsupported-operation failures stay typed. Build deterministic synchronous and asynchronous array writer interpreters over ArrayDescriptor, ChunkProvider or AsyncChunkProvider, the existing regular grids, default and v2 chunk keys, scalar carriers, transpose, byte codecs, CRC32C, gzip providers, and start/end indexed sharding. Metadata is rendered and created last as the array completion marker; partial object-store failure may leave unreachable data objects and must return an incomplete receipt rather than claim transactional publication. Keep the JVM directory adapter as a stronger atomic staging-and-rename interpreter over the shared engine. Add a portable SHA-256 receipt implementation, byte/object/chunk/resource counters, fill omission, deterministic ordering, prefix-safe keys, scalar/empty/rank-five cases, direct and sharded writes, conflict and provider failure, async backpressure, and re-open/read parity on JVM and Scala.js. Gates: JVM and JS writer suites, all common data types and transpose, optional external codec provider, Zarr-Python reads of Scala output, Scala reads of Python-equivalent output, no overwrite/mutation/append API, no filesystem or Future policy in the pure planner, and no domain-specific BIDS or NeuroArchive concepts in core.
set.title: Zarr Z8.4: portable create-only writer interpreters
